routeEvidenceScope: kernel route and bridge metadata; not authenticated USER()

producerCorrection.defect: five boolean system-variable values were emitted as bare ON/OFF tokens, invalid JSON
producerCorrection.fix: SELECT CASE maps native ON/1 to integer1 and OFF/0 to integer0; unknown values become NULL and fail the unchanged strict validator

readOnlyFirst.transport: fixed exact-CID local Unix socket inside container; root private /run/secrets/admin.cnf remains inside custody
readOnlyFirst.clientEnvironment: clean fixed PATH and HOME; no inherited MYSQL_* or option files
readOnlyFirst.sqlInput: exact hash-pinned metadata SQL through stdin, no arbitrary flags, --force, SQL or database overrides
readOnlyFirst.result: strict JSON exact-field schema; no credentials, password hashes, privilege JSON, connection IDs or source records
readOnlyFirst.requires: exact physical envelope/healthy engine/source libraries/original evidence/route revalidated before connection; metadata validator before=false passes

lockedProbeCreation.requires: fresh read-only preflight and complete account-name absence; exact fixed CREATE USER only
lockedProbeCreation.postflight: same fixed metadata SQL; after=true validator requires exact host/locked/no password/no alternate auth/no privileges/no grant rows/no roles plus unchanged existing account count and server-side double-hash fingerprint
lockedProbeCreation.failure: preserve intent, private native exit/captures and partial account state; CREATE USER may have committed; no automatic rollback/retry/drop/unlock/adoption

later: A locked host account is not assumed to resolve pre-auth admission. A separately selected no-auth TLS qualification must measure that outcome. Restore, recovery and real restricted runtime remain separate.
